item.title: SonoMusette at the Sebastiani Theatre
item.description: The concert hall on the Sonoma Plaza with the Italian name will be magically transformed into an intimate, mid-century Parisian neighborhood bistro on Friday evening, Feb. 6.

item.title: He made Super Bowl commercials. Now he’s showing his art in Sonoma
item.description: Before pivoting to art, Steve Stone worked in the creative side of advertising, overseeing the creation of Super Bowl commercials for Electronic Arts, Morgan Stanley and Yahoo. His first solo art show opens this month in Sonoma.

item.title: State of the Valley: Local, state leaders warn of ‘uncertain times’ but pledge unity
item.description: The 2026 State of the Valley served as both a fiscal and political briefing and a celebration of the Valley people and organizations who, as speakers said, make Sonoma uniquely equipped to face this year's anticipated challenges.

item.title: Look who attended North Bay Business Journal’s Book of Lists reception
item.description: The North Bay business community gathered Thursday, Jan. 29, at Luther Burbank Center for the Arts for a premiere networking event – the 2026 Book of Lists. Compiled by the North Bay Business Journal, the book lists top industry leaders, innovators, professionals and services in the region. See photos of who was in attendance.

item.title: Anti-ICE, anti-Trump protesters gather in Sonoma Plaza, joining national movement
item.description: Sonoma Valley residents gathered at Sonoma Plaza twice Friday, Jan. 30, as part of a national day of protest against President Trump's anti-immigration policies and to denounce the recent killings of two U.S. citizens by federal immigration agents.
